title: PARDUS Spark Sport 105 prior-platform current page
notes: Current manufacturer China page documents the prior-platform Spark Sport Shimano 105 branch. It specifies an HS-EPS+ carbon frame, HS-HPT carbon fork and fitted 700x28C tires, and claims 20% greater pedaling stiffness than the previous model due to revised tube shapes and HS high-strength carbon. The claim has no published protocol or independent exact-frame measurement, and fitted tire size is not a maximum.
